existing_morse_route.constructive_reduction: Given an index-ordered finite smooth surface handle presentation, cancel a primal spanning tree of zero/one handles and a dual spanning tree of one/two handles. Connected closed oriented chi=0 then has one zero handle, two one handles, one two handle: first orientable band produces annulus, second joins its two boundary circles to produce punctured torus. Actual attaching-map straightening and outer disk filling give torus diffeomorphism. A compact disk has genus zero, one boundary and tree spine; corresponding disk-and-band moves give disk parametrization.
